sloka: त तु मायाप्रतिच्छन्नं माययैव विभीषणः ।वीक्षमाणो ददर्शाथ भ्रातुः पुत्रमवस्थितम् ।। ६.४६.९ ।।।।
transliteration: ta tu māyāpraticchannaṁ māyayaiva vibhīṣaṇaḥ ।vīkṣamāṇo dadarśātha bhrātuḥ putramavasthitam ।। 6.46.9 ।।।।

translations.english: Vibheeshana started looking with occult powers for his brother's son endowed with occult power following occult means and found Indrajith.
